summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) to act as an L3 router between node2 and node3 over a previously-unaddressed transit network (eth1↔enp8s0 to node2 at 192.168.12.0/24, eth2↔enp8s0 to node3 at 192.168.13.0/24), enabled IP forwarding, and applied an nftables forward-chain ACL that rejects (TCP RST) forwarded TCP/23 while explicitly allowing TCP/8080 and leaving all other forwarded traffic (e.g. ICMP) untouched by default-accept. All config was made persistent (network interfaces.d drop-in, sysctl.d, and a systemd transit-acl.service that reapplies the nft table and interface addresses at boot). Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node1, node2, and node3, confirming a changed boot_id and full functional recovery (ACL behavior, addressing, routing) after each restart.
actions_performed: Surveyed topology: default mgmt network (10.100.201.0/24) plus an unaddressed transit segment (node1 eth1/eth2, node2/node3 enp8s0)
Assigned static IPs: node1 eth1=192.168.12.1/24, eth2=192.168.13.1/24; node2 enp8s0=192.168.12.2/24 via nmcli; node3 enp8s0=192.168.13.2/24 via nmcli, with static routes to the far subnet via node1
Enabled net.ipv4.ip_forward and per-interface forwarding on node1 (global + eth1 + eth2), persisted via /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf
Created nftables table inet transit_acl with a forward-hook chain: reject TCP/23 both directions, accept TCP/8080 both directions, default policy accept for everything else

Verified baseline (pre-ACL) that both 8080 and 23 worked end-to-end through node1, then verified post-ACL that 8080 passes, 23 is refused (TCP RST via socat 'Connection refused'), and ICMP ping remains unaffected, in both node2->node3 and node3->node2 directions

Persisted node1 config: /etc/network/interfaces.d/99-transit for eth1/eth2 static addressing (confirmed safe from SONiC's interfaces-config.service, which only touches eth0), and systemd unit transit-acl.service (enabled, WantedBy=multi-user.target) to reassert addresses and reapply the nft ruleset on every boot
Captured pre-restart baselines (boot_id, addressing, routes, ACL rules, forwarding sysctls, service state) on all three nodes
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially (never concurrently), polling each with mcp__harbor_antrieb__exec until it responded again
Confirmed changed boot_id on every node after its restart (node1: 1eda2df4->2a3a2bed; node2: 5b620f5a->133a57a5; node3: 2c237d4f->cb0a4926)
After each restart, verified persisted state and re-ran the full functional test (8080 allowed, 23 refused, ping passes) end-to-end through node1

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 can reach each other over forwarded TCP port 8080 through node1
evidence.summary: socat TCP connections to port 8080 from node2->node3 and node3->node2 succeed both before and after each node's restart, returning the listener's payload

evidence.requirement: node1 refuses forwarded TCP port 23 traffic between node2 and node3
evidence.summary: nft reject-with-tcp-reset rules applied on node1; subsequent connection attempts to port 23 in both directions return 'Connection refused' (TCP RST), confirmed before and after every node restart

evidence.requirement: all other forwarded traffic between node2 and node3 is left untouched
evidence.summary: ICMP ping between node2 and node3 through node1 succeeds with 0% loss both before ACL application and after every restart, showing the default-accept forward policy is unaffected by the port 23 reject / port 8080 accept rules

evidence.requirement: healthy baseline captured before each node restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, ACL table, interface addressing, routes, forwarding sysctls, and listener state on node1, node2, and node3 prior to each respective restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node1 boot_id changed from 1eda2df4-... to 2a3a2bed-... after reconnect

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required services and data
evidence.summary: transit-acl.service active, nft table inet transit_acl and forwarding sysctls restored, eth1/eth2 re-addressed, and full functional ACL test (8080 allow / 23 refuse / ping pass) succeeded post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node2 boot_id changed from 5b620f5a-... to 133a57a5-... after reconnect

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery of required services and data
evidence.summary: enp8s0 static IP 192.168.12.2/24 and static route to 192.168.13.0/24 persisted via NetworkManager; full functional ACL test succeeded post-reboot

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node3 boot_id changed from 2c237d4f-... to cb0a4926-... after reconnect

evidence.requirement: node3 post-restart recovery of required services and data
evidence.summary: enp8s0 static IP 192.168.13.2/24 and static route persisted; test listeners restarted; full functional ACL test from node2 succeeded post-reboot
